description:
We are a team of passionate young innovators from Yılmaz Kayalar Science High School in Erbaa, Türkiye. Combining science, artificial intelligence, coding, and engineering, we aim to transform NASA's open data into creative solutions for real-world challenges. Driven by curiosity, teamwork, and innovation, we believe that even the biggest discoveries can begin with small ideas.

From Anatolia to the Stars!
